top_choice_rationale: P001 honours a separable, mature discovery: the Kane-Mele Z2 topological insulator and quantum spin Hall prediction, and Molenkamp's HgTe observation of helical edge conduction, confirmed over about two decades by transport, ARPES and STM, with band-structure theory matching measured spectra. It is distinct from the 2016 topological-phase prize because it needs no magnetic field and is protected by time-reversal symmetry. The attribution gap (BHZ, 3D work) is real but manageable with a narrow citation. P002 is a clean, well-reproduced two-name award that I rank second, with some novelty concern relative to the 2005 and 2012 metrology prizes. No award is the weakest option when a mature, verified discovery is available.
